text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday, who recently saw a rapid surge in fans,
received a proposal for a certain project—
choice_data_list: A fan meeting on a cruise ship?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Since it's their first time trying this,
the event company specifically requested
the immensely popular Marvelous Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It consists of a mini-live and a talk show.
Of course, training comes first, so please feel free to decline—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mee, meee!
Trainer, I wanna do it☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A stage on a ship is simply marvelous☆★
It's definitely, definitely gonna be a blast☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"An Ocean Marvelous with everyone! ☆★☆★
Splish-splash, super excited, Marvelous! ☆★"

"If she's up for it, there's no reason to refuse.
The only question left is whether we can gather enough participants to meet expectations, but—"
choice_data_list: Maybe we should do a little promotion ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Got it-☆★
I'll go tell my friends-☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Mav-chin☆
I saw your message! You're hosting an event, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya will tell her friends too☆
I hope it turns out to be a happy event♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a fan meeting on a boat! That sounds like fun~
Sure thing, I'll have them put some flyers in the shop!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
Neo Universe will... "diffuse."
Assisting... "exchange."

And so arrived the day of the event.
Onboard the ship, the attendees were chatting pleasantly, but—

Is it the effect of the advertising,
or is Marvelous Sunday's fan base just that special?

Among the gathered participants, there was someone
wearing an outfit entirely unimaginable
for something called a "fan meeting."
(Click, click, click)

text_block_list.name: Gentleman in Western Armor
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me, would you happen to know where the mini-live venue is—"
(Wheeze... Wheeze...)

text_block_list.name: Young Man in Eerie Mask
text_block_list.text: Me, too. Please, guide me...
Moving over to the mini-live venue, the surroundings were even more chaotic!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyooone☆★
Maaarvelouuus☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: Maaarvelouuuus!!!!

text_block_list.name: Old Man with a Melodic Voice
text_block_list.text: MARVELOUS！　MARVELOUS！

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sooooo happy
everyone came together today!☆★☆★
Let's all be Marvelous together!☆★"

text_block_list.name: Man with Shaved Forehead
text_block_list.text:
Lady Marvelous!
This one is overjoyed beyond measure—!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Twelve-Layered Kimono
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... how intriguing...
Men and women of all ages, all nationalities, and some participants who looked as though they had crossed through time itself—
choice_data_list: (So this is how popular Marvelous is right now...!)

text_block_list.text:
Her wish to spread the Marvelous all across the world.
I can see plain as day that it's steadily coming true.

Wishes will be rewarded.
Marvelous Sunday would surely laugh and say that's marvelous too.
Just then, the venue was enveloped in a white light—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ? ———Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous???
text_block_list.text: I— Hu— Darling—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You're... me...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —I see, so you came to see me, huh? ☆ From another parallel place, to the very same me! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous???
text_block_list.text: Marvelous... resonates... because...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's right☆ If you and I—and another you and I resonate together★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I just know it—
Marvelous will reach every corner of the universe☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆
I was here the whole time, Trainer★
I was just double-checking something☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The spread of marvelousness is truly infinite☆★
